title: Anyone been to a theme park?
content: Yesterday morning my wife told me she dreamt of being in this place I had been to several times, but I never told her! It's a GIANT theme park, which looks slightly more futuristic than our times, but not super crazy futuristic. Just huge enough to look more advanced than us. There's a giant rollercoaster that goes very high, and it's over a lake/water. There's also a waterpark area, with this giant luxurious large platform quite high, and there are slides and other intermediate platforms, and there's a giant landing pool at the bottom. It's all very open air, very large. There's also a "themed village" area but we don't remember many details about that. Has anyone been to a similar place in their dreams? It blew me away that my wife saw the same stuff I saw
